activation_note: Insufficient deployment evidence; retain legacy fallback.

extra_policy.rationale: Inherited v2 gates remain mandatory. External and chronological tests must also meet the mixed-validation ceilings. At least 100 modern real phishing email representatives and 100 real emails of each class externally are evidence floors, not statistical proof. Unknown provenance cannot mask synthetic dominance. Even a passing candidate remains inactive.

rationale.bands: Both inherited review and high-band validation targets must be feasible; failed targets are explicit.
rationale.calibration: Brier<=0.10 and ECE<=0.05 on validation; source-macro Brier<=0.10/ECE<=0.10 and no source Brier>0.15 prevent large sources masking overconfidence.
rationale.f1: At least 0.90 balances precision/recall; accuracy alone is not a selection criterion.
rationale.false_positives: At most 5% legitimate FPR on mixed validation and each paired transfer; 10% worst-source error is a research ceiling, not an acceptable operational inbox guarantee.
rationale.latency: p95 <=25 ms per normalized text on this CPU, matching the prior lightweight research budget.
rationale.provenance: At least two independently collected modern real-email sources with both classes plus a representative fresh external holdout; synthetic generation and a new release date do not establish this.
rationale.recall: At most 5% missed phishing on mixed validation, 10% on any held-out phishing source; mixed results cannot excuse source failures.
rationale.support: At least 100 independent representatives in each held-out source; small folds are insufficient evidence, not automatic passes.

inherited_policy.selection: Prefer development-gate passes, then 0.50*(1-worst source error)+0.25*LOSO macro recall+0.15*validation F1+0.10*(1-LOSO macro Brier); ties prefer simpler/faster. Final test never selects or tunes.
